adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` call is wrapped in a `try/catch` that only does `console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails")` and then proceeds to return success (`{ message: "Guests added" }`). This makes email-notification failures unobservable to the caller and lacks structured reporting/retry, creating a maintainability/operability gap introduced by the diff, even if the core "add guests" mutation still succeeds.
